criteria.requirement: Add HTMLRenderer keyword-only url_rewriter=None. For actual rendered link/image tokens, call (original_url,"link"|"image") once and require a string return; then run the existing sanitize_url and attribute escaping on the rewritten URL. Preserve visible link text, image alt/title, nested emphasis, reference links and auto links. Default output and raw HTML remain unchanged; callback exceptions propagate and a rewritten javascript URL must not bypass the existing harmful-protocol policy.
